create_cnn_dailymail_summarization_task: create a CNN/DailyMail summarization task config with ROUGE and n-gram metrics for a given dataset split
create_cnn_dailymail_inverse_task: create an inverse CNN/DailyMail task config that generates articles from highlights instead of summarizing
configure_generation_task_metrics: configure ROUGE2, ROUGE-L, ROUGE-Lsum, n-gram overlap, and repetition metrics for a generation task
set_task_generation_limits: set min and max generation length and prompt length limits for a CNN/DailyMail task config
resolve_dataset_file_path: resolve the CNN/DailyMail dataset JSONL file path for a given split and dataset directory
